name: superset-plugin-chart-calendar-filter
description: Calendar Filter Plugin for Apache Superset — interactive calendar heatmap with dashboard cross-filtering
author: Francesco Castaldi <fracas@mapsengineering.com>

scripts.build: npm run build-cjs && npm run build-esm && npm run copy-images && npm run ts-types
scripts.build-cjs: esbuild src/index.ts src/CalendarFilter.tsx src/types.ts src/plugin/index.ts src/plugin/buildQuery.ts src/plugin/controlPanel.ts src/plugin/transformProps.ts src/styles/CalendarFilter.styles.ts src/hooks/useCalendarData.ts src/hooks/useSelectionMask.ts src/utils/themeUtils.ts src/utils/dateUtils.ts src/utils/calendarGrid.ts src/components/MacroShortcuts.tsx src/components/CalendarTooltip.tsx src/components/MonthGrid.tsx src/components/YearOverview.tsx src/components/CalendarModal.tsx --outdir=lib --format=cjs --sourcemap --loader:.png=dataurl
scripts.build-esm: esbuild src/index.ts src/CalendarFilter.tsx src/types.ts src/plugin/index.ts src/plugin/buildQuery.ts src/plugin/controlPanel.ts src/plugin/transformProps.ts src/styles/CalendarFilter.styles.ts src/hooks/useCalendarData.ts src/hooks/useSelectionMask.ts src/utils/themeUtils.ts src/utils/dateUtils.ts src/utils/calendarGrid.ts src/components/MacroShortcuts.tsx src/components/CalendarTooltip.tsx src/components/MonthGrid.tsx src/components/YearOverview.tsx src/components/CalendarModal.tsx --outdir=esm --format=esm --sourcemap --loader:.png=dataurl
scripts.build-clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.dev: esbuild src/index.ts src/CalendarFilter.tsx src/types.ts src/plugin/index.ts src/plugin/buildQuery.ts src/plugin/controlPanel.ts src/plugin/transformProps.ts src/styles/CalendarFilter.styles.ts src/hooks/useCalendarData.ts src/hooks/useSelectionMask.ts src/utils/themeUtils.ts src/utils/dateUtils.ts src/utils/calendarGrid.ts src/components/MacroShortcuts.tsx src/components/CalendarTooltip.tsx src/components/MonthGrid.tsx src/components/YearOverview.tsx src/components/CalendarModal.tsx --outdir=esm --format=esm --sourcemap --loader:.png=dataurl --watch
